# legacy-shared fixture

Legacy (non-SDK) C# projects that share build pieces the way long-lived .NET Framework
solutions do, for `csproj modernize` and the `assemblyinfo` codemod. They build on any OS like
`legacy-csproj`: `Directory.Build.props` gives legacy projects the .NET Framework reference
assemblies as a package, and the tests fill `packages/` the way `nuget restore` would.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `src/SharedAssemblyInfo.cs` | company, product, and version for the solution, linked into Domain and Data (NHibernate's `SharedAssemblyInfo.cs`, SmartStoreNET's `AssemblySharedInfo.cs`, Open Live Writer's `GlobalAssemblyInfo.cs`): outside each project's folder and compiled by the other, so it is never edited (OFR4306) |
| `build/Version.targets` | writes `src/GlobalVersionInfo.cs` (git-ignored) before every compilation and adds it to the `Compile` items in a target, as Open Live Writer's `writer.build.targets` does: not a compile item of any project file |
| `src/Layers.Domain/Properties/BuildInfo.cs` | a checked-in version file with an `<auto-generated>` header, which analyzers do not look at |
| `src/*/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs` | each project's own attributes, which the conversion moves into properties |
| `build/Layers.settings` | settings Domain imports, which set `TargetFrameworkVersion` unconditionally (OFR4308) |
| `.nuget/NuGet.targets` | NuGet 2's package restore, which Data imports through `$(SolutionDir)` without a condition (SmartStoreNET) |

| Project | |
|---|---|
| `src/Layers.Domain` | the bottom layer; `packages.config` with Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3 |
| `src/Layers.Data` | references Domain; `packages.config` with Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1, lower than what Domain passes on once converted (NU1605, OFR4307); `SolutionDir` and `RestorePackages` with the NuGet 2 import |
| `src/Layers.Tests` | references Data, so an SDK-style build would also compile against Domain (NHibernate's `TestDatabaseSetup`); a `PostBuildEvent` in a conditioned group that uses `$(SolutionDir)`; an `AfterCompile` target that the SDK's replaces (OFR4308) |

Converted, the projects keep the shared and generated files as they are and set
`GenerateAssembly<Name>Attribute` to `false` for the attributes those declare, so the SDK does
not generate them a second time (CS0579), and each compiles the same sources and references as
before.
